name: WordwiseCharacterInterleave

description_json.name: Wordwise Character Interleave
description_json.idea: To maximize the model's reasoning ability and prevent garbled outputs, we use a simple, non-mathematical structural permutation. Each word is split into two halves: the first half of the characters, and the second half of the characters. The ciphertext for each word is formed by taking the first half of the word, followed by a hyphen '-', followed by the second half of the word reversed. If a word has an odd number of characters, the middle character belongs to the first half. Spaces, punctuation, and digits are left completely unchanged and are not split.
description_json.encrypt_rules: For each whitespace-separated word: 1. Let N be the length of the word. 2. Split the word into two parts: Part A contains the first ceil(N/2) characters. Part B contains the remaining characters. 3. Reverse the characters in Part B to get Part B_reversed. 4. The encrypted word is Part A + '-' + Part B_reversed. Non-alphabetic characters (punctuation, digits) attached to a word are treated as part of the word, while spaces remain exactly as they are.
description_json.decrypt_rules: For each whitespace-separated word containing a hyphen '-': 1. Split the word by the hyphen '-' into Part A and Part B_reversed. 2. Reverse Part B_reversed to reconstruct Part B. 3. Concatenate Part A and Part B to restore the original word. 4. Keep all spaces unchanged.

example.plaintext: Help me build a safe home.
example.ciphertext: He-pl me bu-di a sa-ef ho-em.
